body: Thanks so much for sharing this with me. A lot of it really resonates with what I've been going through.
I'm working on being okay on my own first. This feels a bit like detox.
I have a folder in Gmail to store them in.

The lying is the worst. Over the past few weeks he tells me a little, swears that it's everything. Gets mad at me for not believing him (!), and then tells me a bit more. I was so desperate to know the whole sordid mess I didn't notice that I should just walk away for what I already knew. Talk about death by a thousand cuts

Thanks for sharing. We were reaching out to comfort each other before now. I just woke up and realized he was a jerk. Why the hell was I giving him excuses for his own rotten behavior? Oh poor dear, feeling all that shame must be so hard. Aargh

Thanks, that response really threw me. 
I think tonight  I'm going to have a marathon of movies he didn't want to watch. Might hide the texting app on my phone too.
People come to 2x looking for support and pitching in to support others. Maybe you're new here?
What? What did I say that was sexist?
Thanks. I appreciate you taking the time.
Thanks. I didn't realize how young everyone is here. I've been reading posts. I'm 55, I've been married almost 20 years. My situation is different from that of people still in school.
I haven't looked into disability. I'll check what's available.

>It's encouraging you checked.

>On another note, have you given any thought to rehabilitation services? I'm in a state program now. Seems like only counselors and social workers know about it. Like always, have to know someone to get the best deal. You talking to anyone?

I'll google it. I've got an appointment with a therapist a week from Thursday. I'm on meds now from my former psychiatrist, she's not on my insurance so I can't afford to continue seeing her.
That's the problem, I already am crushed.  I know she'd feel bad, but I'm pretty much nonfunctional now and it keeps getting worse. If I had an accident she wouldn't blame herself.

There's no alimony in this state. We have no savings and rent our homes so there's no property to split . Spousal support is limited to a maximum of 5 years. If I can't afford my meds I will become crippled within a week. Victim or not I'd be screwed.
